    intro k

  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun _ => inG _)

  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (g : U) (fun _ => inG _)

let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up target

  (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction γ)

        (∀ (r : A) (x : B), f (x * φ r) = f x * ψ r) }

        simp

        rintro f g ⟨hfL, hfR⟩ ⟨hgL, hgR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL, hgL, mul_add],

    (∀ (i : OrbitIndex) (x : B), Subtype.val (basis i) x = x * orbitSum i) ∧
    (∀ g : G, (∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d = g) ↔ orbit g = {g}) ∧
    (∀ [Finite H],
      let T : Subgroup U := ⊥
      let j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T H :=

  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (project a bc de f p))
  let expansion := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex) =>
    Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p)

    MonoidHom.range (hom ad) ⊔
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p.val)))

    ∀ r : Right, ∃ l : Left, leftEval l = rightEval r) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom de)) ∨ Finite G →
    ∃ (replaceCase1 : Left → Right) (replaceCase2 : Right → Left)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The project TikZ fixes the four orientations and boundaries. The translation uses symmetric block groups in the finitely supported permutation group and partitions of one finite set, with singleton blocks allowed. It states the factorial quotient as an exact rational equality and evaluates the four diagrams over Complex. Each binary merge contributes its binomial index. For every legal merge chain the nested typed curls use the inclusions of the successive parabolic groups starting at the image of K, and the binomial product equals the original index. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
